Title: Second Tradition: Domain vs Form of Mist

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
I couldn't find an official answer (only groups.google.com/d/topic/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/uV4jT0IZfeU/discussion)

How long does the +2 intercept effect applies when Second Tradition is played by a tapped vampire?

The text is likely ambiguous:

"to untap and attempt to block with +2 intercept"

The +2 intercept bonus is linked to the block attempt, but nothing says it lasts for the duration of the action.

So if the vampire blocks, and the acting vampire plays Form of Mist*, one could say that if the blocking minion plays a wake effect, the +2 intercept is lost.

*: there could be already a loophole here since one could consider the blocking minion has already lost his +2 intercept, and therefore Form of Mist can't be played.

This concerns also Guard Duty, Open Dossier, Read the Winds, Under Siege.

The real thing that interests me is: how can it last for the duration of the action?

Is there a better way to formulate this? For instance: "Also usable by a tapped prince or justicar, even if intercept is not yet needed, to burn a blood to untap and attempt to block with +2 intercept {for the current action}".

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: The intercept granted by Second Tradition: Domain, Guard Duty, Open Dossier, Read the Winds and Under Siege lasts for the whole action, rather than for the current block attempt.

Messages.Author: FrançoisV
Messages.Body:
From the online rulebook :

> Note that all modifications made to a minion's stealth or intercept remain in effect for the duration of the action. Increased stealth and intercept return to normal after the action is resolved.
